HORIZON EUROPE — RESEARCH AND INNOVATION ACTIONS (RIA)
Topic: HORIZON-CL4-2026-DIGITAL-EMERGING-01

Scope:
Develop next-generation digital twin platforms for industrial manufacturing,
combining edge AI, sensor fusion, and federated learning. The action targets
a measurable contribution to TRL progression from 4 to 6.

Expected Outcomes:
- Open-source reference implementation of an interoperable digital-twin runtime
- Validated pilots in at least two manufacturing sectors
- A standards-track contribution to OPC UA / IEC 62541

Expected Impacts:
- 25% reduction in unplanned downtime across pilot sites
- Demonstrable reduction of CO2 footprint in pilot production lines

Eligibility:
- Open to legal entities established in EU Member States, Associated Countries,
  and other countries listed in Annex C of the Horizon Europe Work Programme.
- A consortium of at least 3 independent legal entities from 3 different
  EU MS / AC is required.
- Türkiye is an Associated Country and is eligible.

Evaluation Criteria:
- Excellence (weight 0.50): clarity and pertinence of objectives, methodology, ambition.
- Impact (weight 0.30): pathway to impact, dissemination and exploitation.
- Implementation (weight 0.20): work plan, consortium, allocation of resources.

Page Limit: 45 pages total for Part B (Sections 1, 2, 3 combined).

Submission language: English.

Deadlines:
- Submission deadline: 2026-09-15 17:00 Brussels time.
- Indicative GA signature: 2027-03-01.

Indicative budget: EUR 8 million per project. Total call budget: EUR 80 million.
